data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'kadhaha' which means 'to console' or 'to comfort'. In Islamic tradition, Kaadiha represents a gentle and compassionate soul, always ready to offer solace and support. The name Kaadiha carries the meaning “Gentle, Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaadiha usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Kaadiha
in_english.meaning: Kaadiha means a girl who serves or works in the house of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kaadiha originates from the Arabic root 'ك-د-ه' (k-d-h), which means to serve or to work hard. This name symbolizes humility, diligence, and a commitment to serving others, reflecting important values in Islamic tradition.
